_note: The larder and the bench. **Eight ingredients and all twenty-eight pairs**, which is C(8,2) — a table a person can author and a lint can prove complete, the same argument the ten experts make. An ingredient is deliberately **not** a component: no PieceKind, no CATALOG entry, no grid among the five, because adding to the catalogue moves the save fingerprint and there is a player mid-run. It has a footprint because the retort is a shape and two ingredients have to be arranged in it rather than merely owned. Which ingredient a creature drops is keyed by its **art family**, so a creature added to enemies.json without a family — which already fails a test — cannot arrive without a drop either. What a brew gives is a `Gives`, which is `deny_unknown_fields` on a struct rather than a free map: serde drops a key it does not know without a word, and that is the eight-skill-nodes failure waiting to happen again.

ingredients.name: Kettle Scale
ingredients.blurb: It comes off anything the works made, in sheets, and it is warm for about a minute.

ingredients.name: Toad Ichor
ingredients.blurb: Nine planes over they render it for lamp oil. It does not burn here and nobody has worked out why.

ingredients.name: Cairn Dust
ingredients.blurb: What is left in the dish when a surveyor's stone has been ground and the grinding written up.

ingredients.name: Rust Bloom
ingredients.blurb: Iron that has been damp for eleven years grows this, and it is the colour of a signature.

ingredients.name: Tallow Drip
ingredients.blurb: Off a candle that was lit for somebody. The office does not record who and the drip does.

ingredients.name: Silt Pearl
ingredients.blurb: Silt is eleven inches of what a lake was standing on. Now and then it makes one of these.

ingredients.name: Reef Salt
ingredients.blurb: Scraped off the eleventh reef, which the tenth sheet has a line for and no figure against.

ingredients.name: Bone Meal
ingredients.blurb: Ground fine, sieved twice, and counted — because the register will not take a thing it has not been handed.

brews.name: Lamp-Oil Wash
brews.blurb: It goes on the arms. It is warm and then it is not, and in between you swing harder.

brews.name: Works Whitewash
brews.blurb: The coat they put on a kiln before firing. It holds one thing off you for about as long.

brews.name: Searing Draught
brews.blurb: Warm scale in bloom. Whatever you are carrying will set light to something.

brews.name: The Long Shift
brews.blurb: What the works hands out at the fourth doorway. It keeps you standing, and nothing else.

brews.name: Flue Draught
brews.blurb: Cold at the top, warm at the bottom, and it moves. So do you.

brews.name: Brine and Scale
brews.blurb: It tastes of the works and of the eleventh reef, which have never met.

brews.name: The Foreman's Ration
brews.blurb: Four hundred Sprocketmen are still in the workings and this is what they were sent.

brews.name: The Ninth Plane
brews.blurb: Somebody brought forty and did not stay. This is what was in the jars.

brews.name: Signature Oil
brews.blurb: The colour of a signature, and it gets into everything you touch.

brews.name: The Unlit Candle
brews.blurb: Rendered for a lamp and never lit. It gives the whole of what it was keeping back.

brews.name: The Wading Measure
brews.blurb: Toads know where the rim is. This tells you nothing about the rim and helps anyway.

brews.name: Forty and No Stayers
brews.blurb: The dose the register has PENDING against. There is no second line.

brews.name: The Census Tonic
brews.blurb: A hundred and nine species and one line that says PENDING. This is the line.

brews.name: The Tenth Notch
brews.blurb: Ground stone and bloomed iron, in the proportion eleven years of notches suggest.

brews.name: Candle and Stone
brews.blurb: What is put down at a cairn by whoever built the next one.

brews.name: The Drowned Survey
brews.blurb: The third surveyor's stone, and eleven inches of what the lake was standing on.

brews.name: The Eleventh Line
brews.blurb: Blank on the sheet and ruled twice. It is not blank in the glass.

brews.name: Ground and Counted
brews.blurb: Sieved twice and handed over the counter, which is the only way the office takes a thing.

brews.name: The Signed Plate
brews.blurb: Bloom on brass with a candle held under it. The name comes up and stays up.

brews.name: Eleven Years Damp
brews.blurb: The whole of what being left out does, in a glass, taken at once.

brews.name: The Iron Under It
brews.blurb: Every compass carried onto the flat comes back pointing at the ground. This is the ground.

brews.name: The Closing Line
brews.blurb: What the works drinks when a signature is not the right one and the line is closed anyway.

brews.name: The Lit Shallows
brews.blurb: Somebody stood a candle on the water and it stayed. Nobody has explained it.

brews.name: Salt for the Wick
brews.blurb: It burns slower and it burns the whole way, which is the trade every wick is.

brews.name: The Rendered Account
brews.blurb: Both halves of what a body leaves, in the proportion the clergy write down.

brews.name: The Common Ground
brews.blurb: The one part every survey agrees about, and it fits in a pocket.

brews.name: What the Lake Was On
brews.blurb: Eleven inches of it, ground and taken cold. It settles everything.

brews.name: The Eleven Reefs
brews.blurb: Scraped, ground, sieved twice, and counted — and there are still eleven of them.
